title: fix: short message instead of raw oom text in preview

commit.merge_subject: merge: fix: short message instead of raw oom text in preview

description: Opening the 8K clip put 'Failed to allocate a 132710416 byte allocation with ... OOM' on screen (the encoded develop returns a full-size ARGB array). A render failure whose cause chain holds an OutOfMemoryError now shows 'This frame is too large to preview. Lower Preview quality in Settings or open a smaller clip.' (en + tr); PreviewErrors.isOutOfMemory is pure and JVM-tested. Interim: the real fix is the E0b GPU decode path.
